sampling: Last N chronological returns within historical training window; actual n_fit recorded. Use max-fit-obs >= train_days * 288 to avoid truncating the specified window.
execution: Forecast variance resets at each date and each missing interval; each forecast at t uses only returns strictly before t within current run.
innovations: Gaussian QMLE for variance parameters, then two-stage standardized Student-t df fit. Not joint maximum likelihood.
scoring: Joint VaR/ES score only if predicted ES > 0. Paired moving-block bootstrap (default 7 observed days), exploratory; no formal guarantee under long-run dependence.
limits: Model-selection bias, tick data issues and intraday seasonality not eliminated. Sparse series segments are reset. This is risk forecasting, not trading profitability.
